notes: Fixed the Ctrl+K search going dead after closing and reopening it quickly. Restoring a profile backup now asks you to reopen Hybrid to apply it. Also new in recent updates: wedge shapes now face the same way as in Roblox. Generated maps add walk-in buildings, trees, lamps and road edging. Six built-in models were rebuilt. Many animation presets no longer sink into the floor. You can rename and pin chats, and find them with Ctrl+K.
